net_conflict.reason: must be 0: U1 and U9 carry the datasheet pad numbers (2026-11-08); owner decision 2026-11-08 to lower the limit to the observed count

courtyards_overlap.reason: courtyard of the module footprint (derived from the KiCad ESP32-C6-MINI-1, same land pattern) is the antenna keep-out; ring LEDs and parts lie inside it (ADR-0003 option A, decided by spike 7.2; HW-005); only pairs that include U9; 12 to 14 in the best runs of ring4 to ring7; owner decision 2026-11-08 to lower the limit to 14

items_not_allowed.reason: module U9 inside the hook rule area (amendment A-1); only findings on U9; observed 1 on 2026-11-05

footprint_filters_mismatch.reason: the 16 ring LEDs D1 to D16 use the 2020 LED stand-in footprint, not the footprint of the symbol filter (plan 06 section 5); only these refs; observed 16 on 2026-11-07
